data.body_html:
Starlite 2048 is the summer’s hottest ticket in Marbella, but why rush straight to the venue when you can turn the evening into a full Mediterranean experience? A marbella yacht charter starlite 2048 pre concert cruise from Puerto Banús gives you the perfect pre-show ritual: a sunset sail, a swim in the calm waters of the Costa del Sol, and a chilled glass of cava before the music starts. With departures from Puerto Banús, you’re just 6 km from the concert site at Cantera de Nagüeles.

Why Choose a Pre-Concert Cruise?

Starlite 2048 concerts start around 22:00, which means you have the entire late afternoon and early evening free. Instead of sitting in traffic or hanging around a hotel lobby, you can be on the water. A 2-hour cruise is the sweet spot: you’ll have time to motor along the coast, drop anchor for a quick swim, and still get back to port with 45 minutes to spare before the show. If you want to make a full day of it, upgrade to an 8-hour charter and explore as far as Cabopino or even Estepona.

Our Fleet for Starlite Evenings

We operate from Puerto Banús, so you’re within minutes of the action. For a pre-concert cruise, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are the most popular choices – both are fast, comfortable, and priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. That price includes the skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT, so you know exactly what you’re paying.

If you’re celebrating a special occasion or travelling with a bigger group, step up to the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax). At €4,719 for a 4-hour charter, it’s a premium option that includes a free jet ski – a fun way to burn off pre-concert energy. We also have the Mangusta 80 (Grey) variant, identical in size and price. For other boats like the Ferretti 94 (29m) or Canados 86 (26m), pricing is on request via WhatsApp – just ask and we’ll send a tailored quote.

What’s Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed skipper (English and Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire cruise
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden costs

Sample Itinerary: Sunset Cruise + Starlite

Here’s a typical plan for a 22:00 show:

TimeActivity
19:00Depart Puerto Banús, head west towards Cala del Faro
19:30Anchor for a swim (water temp ~24°C in July)
20:15Sail back, enjoy sunset and drinks
21:00Return to port, transfer to Starlite (15–20 min drive)
22:00Concert starts – you arrive relaxed and refreshed

If you prefer a later start, a 20:00 departure works too – just skip the swim and enjoy the golden hour from the bow.

Best Spots to Anchor Near Marbella

On a short pre-concert cruise, you don’t want to waste time. The best anchorages close to Puerto Banús are Cala del Faro (a small cove just east of the port) and Cala Cortés (a sandy bay near the Marbella Club). Both are sheltered, with clear water and usually calm in the evening. If you have more time, head towards Cabopino – about 20 minutes away – where you can anchor off the dunes and watch the sun set behind La Concha mountain.

How to Book Your Pre-Concert Charter

Booking is simple. Use our [Marbella yacht charter hub](/) to browse the full fleet, then send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, boat, and group size. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online. For other boats, we’ll send a personalised quote within minutes. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during Starlite season when demand is high.

Need a bigger boat for a group of 12? Check out our large yacht charter options for more ideas.

What About Transfers to the Venue?

Puerto Banús is just 6 km from Cantera de Nagüeles, where Starlite 2048 is held. A taxi takes 15–20 minutes and costs around €15–20. We can arrange a private minibus for groups of 6 or more – just mention it when booking. If you’re driving, there’s parking at the venue, but it fills up fast, so arriving by taxi or private transfer is more reliable.

Make It a Full Day: 8-Hour Charter

For the ultimate Starlite experience, book an 8-hour charter and spend the day exploring the coast. Head east to Estepona or even Sotogrande for lunch, then cruise back in the late afternoon. With the Azimut 39 or Astondoa 40, you’ll have plenty of time to swim, sunbathe, and enjoy a leisurely meal on board. The 8-hour rate of €2,299 is excellent value when split between 9–11 guests – that’s under €250 per person for a full day on the water plus the concert.
